description: Svelte SPA embedded in Go binary for virtual model management with visual condition builder

phases.title: Scaffold Frontend Project
phases.description: Initialize Svelte 5 + Vite + Tailwind CSS project in web/ directory. Configure build output to web/dist/. Create base component structure and API client.

phases.title: Backend API Addition
phases.description: Add GET /api/v1/metadata/fields endpoint to serve field definitions. Mount in router.

phases.title: Core Components
phases.description: Build the condition builder (FieldSelector, OperatorSelector, ValueInput) and sort builder components with type-aware predicate selection.

phases.title: Virtual Model CRUD Views
phases.description: Build list view, create/edit form, resolved preview, delete confirmation. Wire up to API.

phases.title: Go Embedding & SPA Serving
phases.description: Embed web/dist/ in Go binary via go:embed. Add SPA catch-all route to chi router. Handle static assets.

phases.title: Polish & Auth
phases.description: Login prompt for admin key, error handling with toasts, responsive layout, dark theme.
